_comment: Grandfathered apps/admin complexity/cognitive-complexity debt, F06 option B (2026-08-10). Single source of truth for BOTH eslint.config.mjs's grandfather block (file-level: relaxes every function in a listed file back to warn/15 in `npm run complexity`) and check-admin-complexity-drift.ts's ratchet (per-VIOLATION: only the exact (rule, file, reason) triples below are tolerated at the strict error/9 check -- see that script's header). A prior full ceiling->9/9 pass across apps/admin (ADS-memory/reports/refactor/2026-08-06-complexity-ceiling-brief.md, ADS-memory/reports/handoffs/2026-08-06-admin-complexity-round-audit.md) was started and paused by the owner in favor of a <=15 warn bar; the violations below are the ones that pass never reached. Delete a violation once it no longer reproduces -- do not add a new one to silence a NEW finding; refactor it instead (or get an explicit, reviewed exception). Test files (apps/admin/src/**/__tests__/**, apps/admin/src/**/__measurements__/**) are never listed here -- eslint.config.mjs excludes them from the error/9 gate entirely rather than grandfathering them as debt; see that file's comment on the block for why.
_comment_2026-09-05_per_function: SCHEMA CHANGE 2026-09-05: replaced the old per-FILE `files: [{file, note}]` shape with a per-VIOLATION `violations: [{rule, file, reason, note}]` shape, mirroring src-complexity-debt.json / check-src-complexity-drift.ts's multiset diff (rule, file, reason). The old file-level shape let `check-admin-complexity-drift.ts` treat 'this file is on the debt list' as license for EVERY function in it, not just the recorded one -- confirmed as a real, not hypothetical, gap: apps/admin/src/lib/api.ts's `request` had drifted from the recorded 12/10 to 17/16 with the ratchet reporting green throughout (the whole file was already grandfathered), and apps/admin/src/lib/assistant-transport.ts's `buildLocalCliContextRef` sat at 18/13 and was NEVER on the debt list at all -- masked because `translateRunAgentPayload`'s entry covered the whole file it lived in. Both are now fixed (request: 3/<=1: buildLocalCliContextRef: 1/0) and this schema change closes the mechanism, not just this one instance: `reason` is ESLint's own message text (includes the function name and the exact measured number), so a debt entry only tolerates that EXACT violation -- any other function in the same file, or the same function at a DIFFERENT number, is a new violation the gate will fail on. `eslint.config.mjs`'s file-level relax block is UNCHANGED (ESLint flat config has no function-level scope, so `npm run complexity` still relaxes the whole file to warn/15 for any file with at least one grandfathered violation) -- the enforcement fix lives entirely in check-admin-complexity-drift.ts, which already ignores that relax block via its own --rule override.
_comment_2026-09-05_reaudit: Re-measured every entry from the prior (2026-08-14) capture directly with `npx eslint <file> --rule complexity:9,sonarjs/cognitive-complexity:9` on 2026-09-05. Six of eight files no longer reproduce ANY violation and were deleted (not rebaselined): App.tsx (recorded 13/12, now 6/5), Media.tsx (13/21, now 5/4), Pages.tsx (11/9, now 9/8), ComposioKeyField.tsx (10/7, now 9/6), SettingsUi.tsx (10/7, now 8/6), api.ts's `request` (12/10, now 3/<=1). Two genuinely still violate and stay, with their recorded reason updated to the live measured text: Seo.tsx's `SeoEntryPanel` (still 25 cyclomatic / 6 cognitive -- cognitive clears 9 so only the complexity rule fires; confirmed genuine flat fan-out over eleven independent `??` form-field fallbacks, see its own in-file EXEMPTION comment; the one real fix is blocked by two characterization tests that pin its independent fallback as a deliberate DI seam) and assistant-transport.ts's `translateRunAgentPayload` (recorded stale at 12, now 13 cyclomatic / 5 cognitive -- the file's own `@complexityExemption` comment is ALSO stale at '12 cyclomatic / 3 cognitive' but that is an in-source comment, out of scope for this pass, which touches development/scripts/**, eslint.config.mjs, and this JSON only; carries a documented, reviewed rejection of a `Record<string,fn>` lookup-table refactor because it loses TypeScript exhaustiveness over the discriminated union it switches on).

violations.reason: Function 'SeoEntryPanel' has a complexity of 25. Maximum allowed is 9.
violations.note: SeoEntryPanel: cyclomatic 25, cognitive 6 (limit 9/9) -- confirmed genuine flat fan-out, not seam-default ceremony: this file's own in-code EXEMPTION comment (2026-08-06) attributes the bulk of the 25 points to eleven flat `??` fallback chains on form fields (`fieldValue(key, resolved.X ?? default) ?? default`), none of them seam defaults. The one real fix is blocked by two characterization tests that deliberately pin its independent fallback behavior as a DI seam -- not forced without breaking that seam.

violations.reason: Function 'translateRunAgentPayload' has a complexity of 13. Maximum allowed is 9.
violations.note: translateRunAgentPayload: cyclomatic 13, cognitive 5 (limit 9/9) -- carries a documented, reviewed `@complexityExemption` in-file comment: a `Record<string,fn>` lookup-table refactor was tried and rejected because it loses TypeScript exhaustiveness over the discriminated union this function switches on. Stays grandfathered; the in-file comment's own score (stale at 12/3) is out of scope for this pass.
